西.meaning_line: Pictograph: a bird's nest. A nest in origin; borrowed for 'west'. Modern sense: west.

填.meaning_line: Semantic 土 (earth; soil) + phonetic 真 (true, てん). To fill earth into a gap. Modern sense: fill in.

働.meaning_line: Semantic 亻 (person) + phonetic 動 (move, どう). A person moving: to work (a Japanese-made kanji). Modern sense: work.

驚.meaning_line: Semantic 馬 (horse) + phonetic 敬 (respect, けい). A horse startled: to be surprised. Modern sense: wonder.

襟.meaning_line: Semantic 衤 (clothing) + phonetic 禁 (prohibit, きん). The collar of a robe. Modern sense: collar.

郵.reading_line: On ゆう is learned with the kanji; the components give the meaning, not the sound. Kun しゅくば (native reading, tied to the meaning).

便.meaning_line: 亻 (person) + 更 (renew). A person changing posture to be comfortable: convenience. Modern sense: convenience.
便.reading_line: On びん is learned with the kanji; the components give the meaning, not the sound. Kun たより, いばり (native reading, tied to the meaning).

弁.reading_line: On べん is learned with the kanji; the components give the meaning, not the sound. Kun わきまえる, わける (native reading, tied to the meaning).

多.meaning_line: 夕 (evening ×2). Two evenings stacked: many. Modern sense: many.

通.meaning_line: Semantic ⻌ (walk) + phonetic 甬 (bronze bell, つう). To go through. Modern sense: traffic.

図.meaning_line: Semantic 囗 (enclosure; map border) + phonetic 啚 (remote area, と). A plan drawn inside a border: a map. Modern sense: map.

絵.meaning_line: Semantic 糸 (silk; thread) + phonetic 会 (meet, かい). Coloured silk: a picture. Modern sense: picture.
絵.reading_line: On え ← phonetic 会 (かい); exact match in the series. Standalone word: 絵 (え).
